ANTZ Primary icons: v2.1 (style locked), 30 icons

Illustrative tile badges, 48 grid, a short story beat then rest. v2.1: the accent is the brand green (onPrimaryFixedVariant) and sits only on the light fill, never on the tile. SVG (CSS keyframes, themed by --antz-* variables) next to the Lottie file for the selected scheme. Draft for review.

Home

home · base home_health · 4050 ms · peaks 14%, 46%

Welcome home: the door light switches off and glows back on with a flicker, then a puff of smoke rises from the chimney, then rest.

Dashboard

dashboard · base grid_view · 4100 ms · peaks 23%, 33%

Dashboard: the widgets refresh one after another, each pulsing as its green mark flashes in, then rest.

Animals

animals · base animal · 3400 ms · peaks 32%, 47%

Paw trail: the trail print fades in, then the front paw lifts and presses down with a puff of dust, then rest.

Species

species · base animal · 3050 ms · peaks 22%, 36%

Taxonomy: the stacked level cards fan out, the paw on the front card pops, and the cards settle back, then rest.

Family tree

family_tree · base breeding_pair · 3100 ms · peaks 14%, 42%

Parentage: the pair leans together, a line drops from them and their offspring pops in at its end, then rest.

Medical

medical · base medical · 3000 ms · peaks 20%, 35%

Heartbeat: the ECG line re-draws across the bag; the cross beats once (lub-dub) as the spike passes, then rest.

Hospital

hospital · base local_hospital · 3150 ms · peaks 18%, 44%

Admission: a paw print walks up and in through the door, then the cross beats once, then rest.

Pharmacy

pharmacy · base medication · 3200 ms · peaks 22%, 34%

Dispense: the cap flips up, a capsule pops out of the bottle and the cap snaps shut, then rest.

Lab

lab · base lab_request · 3800 ms · peaks 14%, 32%

Experiment: the liquid sloshes and settles while three bubbles rise from it one after another, then rest.

Eggs

eggs · base egg · 4200 ms · peaks 16%, 52%

Hatching: the egg wobbles in its nest, a crack draws across, the top lifts and a chick peeks out, then it settles closed.

Housing

housing · base enclosure · 3250 ms · peaks 14%, 28%

Enclosure: the fence pickets are hammered in one after another, then the shelter window lights up green, then rest.

Move animal

move_animal · base move_in · 3300 ms · peaks 16%, 30%

Move: the arrow draws back, then pushes in through the door and the paw slides in with it, then rest.

Diet

diet · base dietitian · 3350 ms · peaks 20%, 34%

Feeding: the apple lifts out of the bowl and drops back in, and the food bounces as it lands, then rest.

Kitchen

kitchen · base cooking_pot · 3450 ms · peaks 20%, 32%

Cooking: the pot lid lifts and tilts as steam rises from under it, then the lid settles, then rest.

Mortality

mortality · base mortality · 3500 ms · peaks 24%, 42%

Remembrance: a single leaf drifts slowly down beside the still skull, swaying, and fades, then rest.

Necropsy

necropsy · base necropsy · 3550 ms · peaks 20%, 36%

Examination: the scalpel lifts and glides along the tray as its marking line re-draws, then rest.

Assessments

assessments · base assessment · 3600 ms · peaks 14%, 36%

Checklist: the board is picked up, its two checks tick in one after another, then it settles, then rest.

Transfers

transfers · base transfer · 3650 ms · peaks 20%, 36%

Hand-off: the crate slides off to the right along the arrow and arrives back from the left, then rest.

Requests

requests · base request · 3700 ms · peaks 20%, 34%

Approval: the stamp lifts and presses down on the slip, and the check pops in as it springs back, then rest.

Notes

notes · base note · 3750 ms · peaks 20%, 36%

Journal: the pencil writes the newest line across the note, then lifts off, then rest.

Announcements

announcements · base announcement · 3850 ms · peaks 18%, 32%

Broadcast: the megaphone draws back and pushes forward as its rays burst out, then rest.

Notifications

notifications · base bell · 3900 ms · peaks 14%, 26%

Alert: the bell swings and rings, its clapper lagging, with two ring arcs flashing out, then rest.

Chat

chat · base chat · 3950 ms · peaks 14%, 60%

Typing: the three dots hop in a wave, twice, then the bubble pops as the message is sent, then rest.

Reports

reports · base bar_chart · 4000 ms · peaks 14%, 34%

Insight: the bars grow up from the baseline one after another, then rest.

Staff

staff · base people · 4150 ms · peaks 14%, 42%

Team: a colleague ducks behind and steps back up beside the staff member, whose badge flashes, then rest.

Department

department · base account_tree · 4250 ms · peaks 18%, 34%

Org chart: the teams fold into the head unit, it pulses, and the teams branch back out one after the other, then rest.

Security

security · base encrypted · 4300 ms · peaks 13%, 42%

Verified: the shield’s check re-draws and the shield seals with one pulse, then rest.

Compliance

compliance · base verified · 4350 ms · peaks 18%, 40%

Certify: the seal lifts off the page and stamps back down, and its check draws in, then rest.

Activity log

activity_log · base history · 4400 ms · peaks 14%, 32%

Log: the clock rewinds, then its hands sweep forward as the elapsed arc re-draws round the face, then rest.

Settings

settings · base settings_gear · 4450 ms · peaks 12%, 34%

Tuning: the big gear winds back and turns forward, driving the small gear the other way, then settles, then rest.

Wall: all 30 icons at 48 px, in nav order (scrub to pause every icon at the same loop position)
